thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Pager: elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2 — paging alex.w (primary). Auto-sampling shows a spike starting ~1009876500, p95 latency up, 503 rate ~6%.

alex.w: acked. jumping in. is there customer impact? any broad outages?

maria: hey — seeing increased 503s for a subset of requests (long context + batch). Small number of customers complaining about timeouts, not full outage. traffic ~15% above baseline.

sam: re-ran quick query against metrics:
```
# prometheus
sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",status!~"2.."}[1m])) by (status)
```
sam: shows 503s and 502s trending up, 200s still dominant. KV cache hit-rate dropping for affected hosts.

alex.w: primary here. quick plan: 1) enable regional fallback to smaller model in us-west-2 for low-tier customers, 2) scale batcher pool, 3) temporarily lower max-context for heavy requests via routing policy. who can run the scale?

maria: I can scale batchers now. running: `infractl scale batcher --region usw2 --count +6` — will monitor.

runbook-bot: Runbook: Retry queue + Thundering Herd (internal) — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/retry-queue 
runbook-bot: Suggested steps: drain retry queue -> enable circuit-breaker thresholds -> fallback to model-small-1 for non-premium traffic.

sam: scaling started, ETA ~45s. also pushing a temporary routing rule:
```
routecfg apply --name reduce-heavy-context --matcher "context_len>4096 and customer_tier!=enterprise" --action fallback:model-small-1
```

maria: batchers healthy +6 active. KV cache leader logs show a burst of evictions — increased GC pressure on host-gpu-23. I isolated that host and marked it drainable.

alex.w: doing canary route change to shift 10% of traffic to fallback.

sam: canary in. 10% -> fallback. 503 rate on canary slice down by ~70% already.

maria: customer-facing retry queue size: 4.1k -> 1.2k after drain running. still seeing some retries accumulate for long-context jobs.

alex.w: good. set escalation: Maria primary owner for remediation until 21:30 UTC, Sam secondary. I'll hand off at 21:00 UTC unless things look bad. coverage gap: none for next hour.

maria: noted. open action items: 1) investigate GC tuning on host-gpu-23 (owner: maria) 2) verify routing rule rollback plan (owner: sam) 3) communicate to support with short blurb (owner: alex.w).

sam: I'll prepare rollback command and alerting tweak. rollback snippet: `routecfg rollback reduce-heavy-context --to-revision 3` — testing in canary before full.

alex.w: quick customer blurb for support: "We're seeing transient 5xx on some long context requests in us-west-2. Mitigations are in place (fallback model + scaled batchers). No broad outage; some requests may see errors or slower retries. We'll update in 30m." feel free to copy. :thumbsup:

maria: ops note: I'll also file a follow-up runbook issue for improved eviction monitoring. link will be added to the incident thread.

alex.w: status update for handoff: mitigations applied, canary healthy, batchers scaled, retry queue draining. Next check-in at 21:00 UTC or sooner if pages resume. Leaving primary to maria at handoff time.

maria: taking over primary at 21:00 UTC. adding monitoring dashboards to thread: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/retry-queue-usw2

sam: added temporary alert suppression for noisy 502s to avoid paging flood while we stabilize. will remove suppression after full rollback or steady state.

alex.w: thanks team. if anything escalates ping @maria and @sam directly. otherwise i'll follow up in morning with long-form incident recap. :coffee:

runbook-bot: Incident note recorded: incident-ref=rq-1009876543, severity=sev2, mitigations=scale-batcher,fallback-model,drain-host,owner=maria"
